title: Legal source of Amendment 190 age ceilings
answer: the Tax Authority's ruling 6849/15 (published 5.5.2015) lets a managing company withhold 15% on commuting a recognized annuity without an assessing officer's approval when exempt payments stay within age ceilings set by its factor table (4 or 5 times the average wage times the factor) and deposits above the s.45A and s.47 maximums are marked as exempt payments (TXA-30, TXA-24, TXA-23)

source.title: רשות המסים, החטיבה המקצועית: תמצית החלטת מיסוי 6849/15 "הסדר ניכוי מס במקור בעת היוון קצבה מוכרת – החלטת מיסוי בהסכם" (פורסמה 05/05/2015)
source.quote: עד גיל 60 התקרה הינה הסכום הדרוש לקצבה של 4 פעמים השכר הממוצע במשק, כהגדרתו בסעיף 3(ה3) לפקודה, החל מגיל 60

phase_b: A 2017 adviser presentation on the Insurance Association's site named 'החלטת מיסוי 6849/15'; the Tax Authority's ruling-summary app (secapp.taxes.gov.il, reached by plain form post, area 'קופות גמל ומיסוי יחיד', subject 'קצבה מוכרת') returned summary 20150026 with the facts, the arrangement and the factor table; the funds' 2026 ceilings in TXA-24 equal these factors times 13,769. New rule TXA-30 written; TXA-22, TXA-23, TXA-24 updated.
notes: docs/method.md G-24 and compare.server.ts tier2Table use TXA OQ9 as the Amendment 190 blocker (its build check requires G-24 to name the question): the lead decides whether Amendment 190 deposits graduate or the blocker moves to the still-open TXA OQ11, OQ14 or OQ15. The file's Graduation status (Amendment 190 paragraph), its Summary ('The legal source of those ceilings was not found') and coverage.md line 119 still call OQ9 and OQ10 open. New rule TXA-30 with '- Scope: general': the ruling was made with one unnamed managing company, but the Tax Authority's summary search presents published summaries as its official position for similar circumstances; scope call for the lead and the scope agent, and a data/rules record may be needed. TXA-22, TXA-23 and TXA-24 now cite the ruling (primary) beside the fund documents; their Scope lines were not touched. The ruling link needs the session the search page sets (a person opens the search page first).

title: Basis of age-60 and three-payslip conditions
answer: both are conditions of the Tax Authority's ruling 6849/15 for withholding 15% without an approval: "העמית הינו בן 60 או יותר" and "העמית מקבל קצבה מזערית ... והציג שלושה תלושי שכר" (facts 1.4, 1.5) (TXA-30, TXA-22, TXA-27)

source.title: רשות המסים, החטיבה המקצועית: תמצית החלטת מיסוי 6849/15 "הסדר ניכוי מס במקור בעת היוון קצבה מוכרת – החלטת מיסוי בהסכם" (פורסמה 05/05/2015)

phase_b: Not site-dependent itself; closed with the same source found for TXA OQ9.
notes: The file's Graduation status and coverage.md line 119 name OQ10 as narrowed/open.

title: Exempt commutation and the recognized annuity together
remains: Whether the s.9A(e)(1) exempt-commutation capacity can be used on recognized-annuity money, and in what order.
settle: The recognized-annuity circular promised in circular 2/2013 or a Tax Authority ruling.

title: The promised recognized-annuity circular
remains: The separate circular on the recognized annuity promised in circular 2/2013 s.2.2.2 was not found.
settle: A re-check of the Tax Authority's professional circulars (a standing re-check).

title: Recognized annuity received before 60
remains: How a recognized annuity received before 60 (outside disability) is taxed.
settle: A Tax Authority circular or ruling on recognized annuities before 60.

title: NII on a recognized annuity and its commutation
remains: The NII and health treatment of the commuted amount, and an NII statement for either case.
settle: An NII publication on contributions from provident-fund annuities and commutations.
phase_b: Read the National Insurance Law (btl.gov.il consolidated copy): s.350(א)(7), p.246, leaves tax-exempt non-work income out of the base except early pension; s.345ב(א), p.243, defines early pension as one paid before retirement age after retiring. By reading, an exempt recognized annuity is outside the base from retirement age; the commutation stays open. Note added.
notes: Method gap G-11 cites it (with TXK OQ9): the reading may let F-28 leave an exempt recognized annuity from retirement age outside the NII base; the lead decides whether a reading is enough.

title: Surtax on the 15% commutation income
remains: Whether the 15% commutation income counts toward the s.121B surtax and whether it is capital-source income for the extra 2%.
settle: A Tax Authority statement on s.121B and s.9A(e)(3) income.

title: Proposed changes to Amendment 190 and policies
remains: The Arbitrage Committee proposals and the 2027 budget's effect on Amendment 190 and savings policies.
settle: A re-check of the 2027 budget and committee outcomes (a standing re-check).

title: Notional redemption of a savings policy
remains: Whether the Tax Authority has a position on The Phoenix's year-end notional redemption and whether it resets the cost basis.
settle: A Tax Authority ruling or instruction to insurers, or the form-867 instructions for insurers.

title: Current form for fixing the annuity exemption
answer: the Tax Authority's service "בקשה לקיבוע זכויות ... (טופס 161ד)", filed with the assessing officer through the personal area (TXP-28)
notes: TXP-16's conditions and 'Likely to change' still say the form was not found (open question 1); coverage.md line 105 lists TXP OQ1 as open.

title: Tax forms on leaving a job
answer: the Tax Authority's new form 161, "הודעה על פרישה מעבודה", parts A to C, and its part B choices (TXP-29, TXP-30)
notes: TXP-19's conditions still say the employee notice and choice forms were not read (open question 2); a rule-text update for the lead.

title: Taxable base of a non-compliant withdrawal
answer: the whole amount paid; reg. 3(1) of the 1962 regulations taxes a member "על אותם כספים" paid against the fund rules at 35%, and Ordinance s.87(ד) applies the ordinary tax instead when it is higher (TXP-18)

source.title: תקנות מס הכנסה (כללים בדבר חיוב במס על תשלומים לקרן שלא אושרה ותשלומים שלא כדין), תשכ"ב-1962 (Wikisource raw text, mirror of ק"ת תשכ"ב 2006)
source.locator: reg. 3(1); with Ordinance s.87(ד), Tax Authority consolidated text p.145
source.quote: חבר בקופת גמל ששולמו לו כספים על ידי הקופה חייב במס על אותם כספים

phase_b: Read the 1962 regulations on Wikisource (no amendment shown) and s.87 in the Tax Authority's consolidated Ordinance (p.145, s.87(א)(2), (ד)); TXP-18's conditions and Source line updated.
notes: Method gap G-06 (F-48 blocked) and the tax_at_exit labels 'early withdrawal's taxable base open (TXP OQ3; G-06)' in pension-comprehensive, pension-general, provident-for-annuity and ira-provident (also their open_questions lists) can be lifted: the base is the whole amount withdrawn, taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate. coverage.md line 105 lists TXP OQ3. The regulations rest on a Wikisource mirror; the original gazette scan is linked there (olaw.org.il takanot-1317.pdf).

title: Which 2025 average wage applied where
answer: the Tax Authority's 2025 booklet, chapter א section 5, applied 13,316 to the employer and severance ceilings and 12,536 to the beneficiary-member test (TXP-03, TXP-10)

title: How the severance ceiling applies over a year
answer: monthly; Income Tax circular 4/2019 s.2.1.1 computes the severance ceiling each month as the lower of the salary on the deposit date times 8.33% and 1/12 of the yearly ceiling, across all employers (TXP-11)

source.title: חוזר מס הכנסה 4/2019 – הפקדות מעסיק לקופות גמל לקצבה – תיקון 232 לפקודת מס הכנסה (31.12.2019), copy hosted by Menora Mivtachim
source.quote: תקרת הפיצויים בחישוב חודשי היא מכפלת משכורתו של העובד ביום ההפקדה בשיעור ההפקדה המרבי לרכיב הפיצויים בקופות גמל לקצבה (8.33%) או 2,833 ₪, שהם 1 חלקי 12 מ"תקרת הפיצויים"

phase_b: Not site-dependent; found in passing while searching TXA OQ9. Added to TXP-11's conditions and Source line (primary, third-party host).
notes: Closed outside the brief's Phase B scope because the source turned up; the gov.il copy of circular 4/2019 was not found (two BlobFolder guesses returned 404), so the source is a third-party copy: the lead may prefer to keep it narrowed until the official copy is found.

title: Whether payroll grants the 45A credit monthly
remains: Whether payroll applies the employee's s.45A credit each month and how a payslip shows it.
settle: The Income Tax (Deduction from Salary and Wages) Regulations 1993 on credits for provident payments, or a Tax Authority instruction to employers.
phase_b: Searched the 2026 deductions booklet: it prints the s.45א(ד) and (ה) credit ceilings per month (189 and 19,400), which suggests but does not state monthly application. Note added.
notes: pension-comprehensive.json lists TXP-OQ6 in open_questions.

title: Age-50 enlarged deduction: 2026 amounts
remains: The guide's 16.5% rate for a beneficiary member (s.47(ב1)) is not in the regulations' mirror text, so the current text is unconfirmed.
settle: The current text of the 1980 regulations on Nevo or in Reshumot.
phase_b: Read the 1980 regulations on Wikisource (ק"ת תש"ם 760, no amendment shown): 10.5% (+6% annuity-only) and 7.5% from age 50, capped at s.47(ב) rates times the s.47(א)(1) ceilings; the guide's 11,508 / 18,084 / 5,820 are those products and the s.47 amounts are frozen 2025-2027, so the 2026 caps are the same by computation. TXP-08 was not edited. Note added.
notes: Method gap G-13 cites it: the 47(ב) caps for 2026 can be computed (7% × 164,400 = 11,508; 11% × 164,400 = 18,084; 5% × 116,400 = 5,820); the beneficiary-member 16.5% route still lacks a current text.

title: Self-employed mandatory deposit: law and 2026 thresholds
remains: The 2026 thresholds rest on Harel's table or a computation from the NII average wage; which average wage the Efficiency Law's definition uses was not read.
settle: The Efficiency Law 2017-2018 definition of the average wage for the self-employed deposit, or a Tax Authority 2026 figure.

notes: Still a tax_at_exit item in provident-for-annuity.json ('how gains on the lump sums the law allows are taxed is open (TXP OQ9)').
